verbose.description: Enable verbose logging — includes detailed packet headers and decoded content in logs.

logdir.description: Directory where dsniff stores captured traffic logs.

logfile_maxsize.description: Maximum size (in bytes) per log file before rotation. 10 MB by default.

logfile_rotate.description: Number of rotated log files to retain. Old files are overwritten after this count.

services.description: List of protocols/services to sniff. If empty or omitted, the default set is used (ssh, ftp, http, etc.).

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor. At least one enabled interface is required.

name.description: Name of the network interface (e.g., eth0, wlan0).

enabled.description: Whether to actively sniff on this interface.

custom_ports.description: Override default port numbers for services (e.g., map 'http' to 8080). Keys are service names, values are port numbers.
